about: Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 SC 3.0 bpw H4 + DFlash2 speculative decoding (3.0 bpw draft) on TabbyAPI, with RDNA4 kernels for gfx1201, as one container; from parth-thakre/exl3-rdna4-recipe
setup: One container for an RX 9070 / 9070 XT (gfx1201): upstream ExLlamaV3 dev 0f685aa with the recipe's RDNA4 patches, built by the recipe's own setup scripts on AMD's ROCm 7.2.4 image, and TabbyAPI a3fed43 unpatched; the runtime image needs no ROCm on the host, only the amdgpu driver. The draft is our 3.0 bpw EXL3 quant of inco.ai's DFlash2 draft (Apache-2.0). Serves 96K context shared by up to 3 concurrent requests, which leaves room for a desktop on the same card (tested with ~1.9 GB already in use); the vision encoder is kept in system RAM.
